```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ISLR)
library(ISLR2)
library(MASS)
```
```{r}
data("College")
attach(College)
```

```{r}
view(College)
```

```{r}
dim(College)
```
```{r}
str(College)
```
```{r}
?College
```

```{r}
pairs(College[,1:5])
```
```{r}
Elite=rep("No",nrow(College))
```

```{r}
Elite[(College$Top10perc>median(College$Top10perc))]="Yes"
College_df = data_frame(College,Elite)
```

```{r}
table(Elite)
```
```{r}
hist(College_df$Apps,xlab = "Applications Received",main = "")
hist(College_df$S.F.Ratio,xlab = "Student/facult ratio",main = "")
hist(College_df$perc.alumni,xlab = "perc alumni",main = "")
hist(College_df$Expend,xlab = "Instructional expenditure per student",main = "")
```
